newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 360 tonnes of lead.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 360 tonnes of lead.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 360 tonnes of lead for $251,536.
Specialty Metals & Minerals bought 100 tonnes at a unit price of 32.26 cents a lb.
Canfield Technologies bought 60 tonnes at 31.85 cents.
Non-Ferrous Processing Corp bought 60 tonnes at 31.51 cents.
Amerway Inc bought 60 tonnes at 31.44 cents.
Ney Smelting & Refining bought 60 tonnes at 31.21 cents.
Parks Pioneer Metals bought 20 tonnes at 31.15 cents.
